Oprah Winfrey is always at the scene of the crime. She has a long history of being close to powerful people who have committed horrifying acts. Additionally, behind the empathic and inspirational persona she has a long trail of controversies and suspicious moments where accountability never quite followed. This video takes a deep dive into Oprah’s rise, her influence, and why so many people believe there’s a darker side to the story we were told.
